# Medical SaMD Fixture

This synthetic fixture describes a software risk-control narrative for a medical
software context without asserting device clearance, clinical performance, or
regulatory conformity.

## Intended Use Record

The record captures user group, operating context, known limitation, and review
owner as separate source-backed statements.

## Change Impact

The workflow links a changed requirement to risk analysis, verification evidence,
and release notes while preserving human review status.

## Non-Claim Boundary

This fixture does not claim medical-device compliance, safety effectiveness,
clinical validation, or market authorization. It only exercises portable corpus
artifact generation with license-safe text.
